# Business Central Agent Skills

Add the following project skill:

```text
.github/skills/bc-implementation-planning/
├── SKILL.md
└── PLAN-TEMPLATE.md
```

`bc-implementation-planning` creates, reviews, updates, resumes, re-plans, and closes persistent execution plans. It complements:

```text
bc-requirement-analysis -> bc-fit-gap-analysis -> bc-solution-design
-> al-technical-design -> bc-implementation-planning
-> al-feature/al-object/al-integration-development
-> al-test-development -> bc-release-readiness
```

Do not rename `SKILL.md`. The `name` value must match the parent directory: `bc-implementation-planning`.
